== Title ==
<span lang="ja">敵ウォーカーを確認</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">敵が惑星位置にＡＴ－ＡＴを配備するか移動した直後に使用する。自分のリザーブデッキの中から最大で3枚までのその惑星の屋外位置を探し出し、即座に配備する。その後リザーブデッキをシャッフルし、カットしてもとの場所に置く。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「エコー・ステーション。3TA。インペリアル・ウォーカーを確認」　反乱軍はウォーカーと反乱軍兵員の間にできるだけ距離を取り、防衛の準備を整えるという戦術に出た。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Walker Sighting.

'''Lore''' — "Echo station. 3TA. Imperial walker confirmed." The Rebels adopted a tactic of putting as much distance as possible between walkers and Rebel troops and preparing a defense.

'''Game text''' — Use immediately after the opponent deploys or moves an AT-AT to a planet location. Search your Reserve Deck for up to three exterior locations of that planet and deploy them at once. Then shuffle, cut, and return the Reserve Deck to its place.

One asterisk precedes 敵ウォーカーを確認. Game text uses 惑星位置 and 屋外位置 for planet site and exterior sites, and says return the Reserve Deck to its place.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-walkersighting.gif|Original English face]], [[Walker Sighting]].</ref>
